reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the fluorine effect, proven for Ti-45Al-8.5Nb, to the HfNbTaTiZr RHEA, but the mechanism assumes analogous fluoride-to-oxide conversion without addressing the vastly different chemistry (no Al to form Al2O3; instead Hf, Nb, Ta, Ti, Zr oxides). The proposal is essentially the future work suggested by P4 ('anti-oxidation coatings are still required') applied with a known coating method, lacking a new mechanistic link or integration of conflicting evidence.
copied_elements: surface fluorine treatment (NaF solution) to improve oxidation resistance
fluorine effect mechanism: formation of transient metal fluorides converting to protective oxide
predicted reduction in oxidation weight gain
idea that anti-oxidation coatings are needed for RHEAs in air
